summary.text: Dometic RM10.5 and RMS10.5 10-series refrigerators are absorber refrigerators that run on 12 V DC, AC mains or liquefied gas. Every fault shows as a warning symbol, a fault ID and a beep: a code on the TFT display or flashing LEDs on LED-panel models.

models.text: The operating manual covers RM10.5, RM10.5S, RM10.5G, RM10.5T, RM10.5P, RMS10.5S, RMS10.5G, RMS10.5T, RMS10.5P, RMS10.5XS, RMS10.5XG, RMS10.5XT and RMS10.5XP.
RM10.5T, RMS10.5T and RMS10.5XT use a TFT display with a control knob; the S, G and P variants use an LED display with ON/OFF, energy-selection and temperature-selection buttons.
The data plate gives the gas pressure the refrigerator may be operated at; Dometic says to use universal LPG only, not natural gas (see data plate).
Technical data: 230 V / 50 Hz and 12 V connection, 135 W at 230 V and 130 W at 12 V, gas consumption below 18.3 g/h, climate class SN.
Dometic's RM10 door support page shows the winter-position part separately for RM/RMS, RMD/RMDT and RML variants, because door handling differs by model.
models.locator: support page 'I can not close the refrigerator door/ice compartment door'

display.text: All faults are indicated by a warning symbol, a fault ID and a beep. The beep lasts 2 min and repeats every 30 min until the error is rectified.
If several faults occur, the display shows the last fault; the underlying faults are displayed after the last fault has been confirmed.
TFT models (RM10.5T, RMS10.5T, RMS10.5XT) show a fault code with a warning symbol in the middle of the TFT display.
LED models (S, G and P variants): the LED warning symbol lights continuously and the other LEDs flash according to the fault.
The manual splits faults into WARNING type (W01, W05, W06, W10, W11, tank stop) and ERROR type (E03, E07-E09, E12-E14, E50-E53).
Tank stop mode: TFT models show a petrol-pump symbol; on LED models the gas LED flashes. Gas operation is blocked for 15 min after the vehicle ignition is switched off.
Door open more than 2 min: TFT models show W10 plus a beep; LED models signal it with a beep.
In stand-alone gas mode the display turns off 2 s after the last activity and switches on briefly every 15 s; it stays on while an error message is present.

reset.text: WARNING type faults reset automatically once the fault has been rectified.
ERROR type faults must be reset manually: TFT models, press the control knob for 2 s; LED models, press the ON/OFF button for 2 s. A beep sounds and the error is reset.
Tank stop mode ends on its own: after 15 min the refrigerator switches back to automatic mode, or select a different operating mode.

checks.text: Park the vehicle level, especially when starting up and filling the refrigerator before setting off.
AC operation not working: replace a defective fuse in the AC power supply and make sure the vehicle is connected to AC power.
DC operation not working: replace a blown vehicle fuse (see the vehicle manual), test and charge the vehicle battery, and switch on the ignition.
Gas operation not working: replace an empty gas cylinder and open a closed gas valve.
Air in the gas line: switch the refrigerator off and on again, three or four times if necessary; if available, switch on the stove and repeat with the refrigerator.
Running on gas in automatic mode while on shore power means mains voltage is too low; no action needed, it switches back to AC when voltage is sufficient.
Not cooling enough: check the ventilation grille is not obstructed, the door closes properly and the seal fits and is undamaged; defrost an iced evaporator; set a lower temperature.
If ambient temperature is high, remove the ventilation grille for a while; remove excess or warm food; recheck the temperature after four or five hours of operation.
Use DC operation only with the engine running and supplying sufficient voltage or with a battery monitor; a vehicle battery management system may switch the refrigerator off.
At altitudes above 1000 m, ignition problems may occur; switch to a different energy source.
Keep the exterior ventilation grilles and roof vent free of dust and dirt, check and clean the condensate drain, and clean the condenser with a damp cloth.

parts.text: AC heating element and DC heating element: if defective, contact an authorized service agent.
Fuse in the DC cable (the fuse on the relay): contact an authorized service agent; only the vehicle fuse is listed as owner-replaceable.
If the compartment temperature sensor is defective the refrigerator runs at maximum power all the time; it can only be repaired by an authorised repair centre.
Gas burner: dirt shows as poor ignition or deflagrations; Dometic recommends cleaning at least once a year, half-yearly or quarterly on LPG.
Absorber unit is under high pressure and must never be opened; the refrigerant circuit is maintenance-free.
Optional R10-BP battery packs take 12 AA batteries in compartments left and right under the operating element and run stand-alone gas mode for 2 to 3 days.

callTech.text: Gas odor: close the gas supply valve and cylinder valve, open all windows and leave, operate no electrical switches, extinguish open flames, and have a specialist check the gas system.
Ammonia smell: switch off the appliance, open all windows and doors, and immediately visit your dealer or a Dometic service provider.
W01, W11 and E03 list only one remedy: contact an authorized service agent.
E07, E08, E09, E12, E13, E51, E52 and E53: reset the error, and contact an authorized service agent if it occurs again.
Work on gas and electrical installations may only be performed by qualified technicians; have the gas system and flues inspected before first use and every two years.
